newsitem.title: USA: Response says reaches deal with Halifax.
newsitem.headline: Response says reaches deal with Halifax.

text.p: Response USA Inc said Wednesday it has reached an agreement with Halifax Fund LP to convert its preferred stock and sell the underlying common stock to certain unaffiliated purchasers.
Response USA said Halifax holds 1,000 shares of its series A convertible preferred stock, which is 14.5 percent of the outstanding shares.
Response said the Delaware Court of Chancery on Tuesday granted partial summary judgment to Halifax with respect to their right to convert preferred stock into common stock.

As previously announced, Halifax filed a lawsuit against Response in February challenging its decision to suspend conversion and seeking specific performance of the certificate of designation provisions concerning conversion of the preferred stock to common stock.
